x: In the mile, Bill Lucas had a grand tussle with Bingham, T.C.C., who won by a few yards in 4m 32 secs., Cohen finishing 3rd. In the field events, Sutton and Jones upheld the club's prestige.
Bill Lucas won the mile, and Shrubb was 3rd. Carter was 2nd in the 2 miles, after a keen tussle with Bingham, T.C.C. Charlie Smart gained points by finishing 3rd.

Les Cohen ran a splendid race in the 3 Miles to beat Maurice Bingham, who was running for the Triangle, and the latter won the team race. The 1 Mile Medley Relay resulted in a win for the Police, with our lads second and the Triangle third.

The first at Belgrave Hall on October 18th received an entry of 14 teams, comprising nearly 100 runners. Bingham, of Finchley, led from the start and eventually won in 30.59. Dan Patience ran very well to finish 3rd.
2 miles (Seniors): 1 Nankivell (S.); 2 Cohen (B.); 3 Bingham (W.M.T.); 4 Eyers (W.M.T.); 7 Gailley; 10 Shields; 12 Morrell; 13 Eeles.

Bingham was about ten yards behind Cole and close to him followed two Northern men, Ellis and Tyrer. The second lap saw no change in the leading positions, but Reid had jumped ahead of Carter, who was running on his own some 15 yards from the Birchfielder.
One Mile: 1 Howell (P.B.); 2 Cohen (B.). 4 mins. 47 secs. Open Two Miles: 1 Bingham (F.); 4 Pearson (B.); 7 Morrell (B.); 8 Eeles (B.); 9 Walker, N.
David Main found his true form in the Mile and won from Nankiwell (Southgate) and Bingham (Finchley) by six yards in 4.37.2. Derrick Burfitt won as he liked in the Youths' One Mile in 4.30.
At the Southern Counties' Championships held at the White City, Len Herbert finished second in the 3 Miles event, and his battle with Maurice Bingham was worth seeing.
